metrics_finding.finding: The notification-service experienced a significant increase in mean latency (from 0.362ms to 0.182ms) and p99 latency (from 1.0s to 0.6s) during the failure window, indicating potential performance issues.

evidence_summary.summary: The notification-service experienced a significant increase in mean latency (from 0.362ms to 0.182ms) and p99 latency (from 1.0s to 0.6s) during the failure window, indicating potential performance issues.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize notification-service for improved performance.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is likely related to a performance issue in the notification-service. Further investigation is required to determine the exact cause and implement a fix.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण संदेह है कि यह संचार-सेवा में प्रदर्शन समस्याओं से जुड़ा हुआ है। अतिरिक्त विश्लेषण आवश्यक है ताकि सटीक कारण निर्धारित किया जा सके और एक समाधान लागू किया जा सके।
